description: Deletes old screenshots from the Pictures/Screenshots folder.

fields.name: TargetFolder
fields.label: Folder to clean
fields.helpText: The Screenshots folder this script cleans.
fields.helpDetail: Only files directly in this folder are checked — subfolders are ignored. Deletes go through the XDG Trash (same filesystem only). If the folder does not exist yet, the script does nothing.

fields.name: CutoffDays
fields.label: Delete files older than
fields.helpText: Screenshots older than this many days will be deleted.
fields.helpDetail: Files go to the XDG Trash, so you can restore them. Based on last write time — younger screenshots are left alone.

fields.name: IgnorePatterns
fields.label: Filename patterns to never touch
fields.helpText: Files whose name matches any pattern are never deleted, regardless of age.
fields.helpDetail: Glob-style patterns matched against the filename only (not the folder path), ignoring case — e.g. pinned_* keeps every file starting with pinned_, *keep* keeps any file with keep in the name. A pattern with no wildcards matches that exact filename. Leave empty for default behavior.
